tool: Built-in image_gen.imagegen, run through `codex exec` with the reference image attached
style: Original cozy gouache and colored-pencil artwork matching the reference atlas; no game assets copied.
cleanup: Opaque fragments under 600 px that are detached from every animal are cleared: fringe specks on all three sheets and two wag marks beside the golden retriever's tail on the side sheet. Painted animal pixels are untouched.
prompts: Production sprite atlas on a TRUE transparent background, alpha zero everywhere outside the animals. Redraw the SAME twenty pets from the attached reference atlas, in the SAME order and grid, keeping each pet's exact colours, markings, fur texture, head-to-body proportions and relative size, in the same original cozy hand-painted gouache and coloured-pencil style: fine irregular cinnamon outlines, tactile paper grain inside the shapes, chubby rounded bodies, tiny dot eyes, soft blush, delicate fur shading, NO hard flat vector shapes. NEW VIEW AND POSE for every pet: seen exactly from the FRONT, walking TOWARD the viewer on all four legs, NOT sitting. The face looks straight at the viewer with both eyes visible and the head centred; the body is foreshortened behind the head; the two front legs show below the chest with ONE front paw lifted in mid-step; the hind legs are partly visible behind; the tail peeks out at one side. A symmetric frontal view, not a three-quarter view. Rabbits step forward on their front paws with the ears up; the lop rabbit's ears hang down. The chick, the duck and the budgie face the viewer standing on two legs with one foot lifted. The hamster and the guinea pig trot toward the viewer on four tiny legs. The hedgehog trots toward the viewer with its face in front of the spiny dome. The tortoise walks toward the viewer with its head forward and one front leg lifted. LAYOUT: exactly FIVE columns and FOUR rows, twenty separate animals, evenly spaced, each centred and entirely inside its own equal cell with ample transparent gaps on all sides so that no animal touches or overlaps a neighbour; consistent scale across the sheet as in the reference; within each row all feet rest on the same invisible baseline. No ground, no floor, no cast shadows, no backdrop, no text, no labels, no borders, no grid lines. ORDER, reading left to right. Row 1: cream kitten, chocolate curly puppy, white upright-ear bunny, tiny buff chick, orange tabby cat. Row 2: black-and-white tuxedo cat, calico cat, siamese cat, corgi, curly cream poodle. Row 3: shiba inu, golden retriever puppy, cream lop-eared rabbit, white duck, blue budgie. Row 4: golden hamster, brown-and-white guinea pig, round hedgehog, green tortoise, cream bunny.
